:::{#rem-column-column-product}
#### Column-column products

Ordinary [matrix multiplication](linear-algebra.qmd#def-matrix-mult) pairs a row of the left factor with a column of the right factor,
which makes each entry a [row-by-column product](linear-algebra.qmd#def-matrix-mult) [@northwestern_linalg_chap1, Section 2].
Each entry of a [cross-product matrix](#def-cross-product-matrix) instead pairs a column of $\matr{A}$ with a column of $\matr{B}$,
so we can call it a column-column product.

:::
